name: Asuryani Paths
note: Ynnari cannot acquire Asuryani Paths (p.20) and Corsair Asuryani abandon their Path, gaining no benefit from it (p.14): both are the notKeyword on every option. Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13): a text requirement. As printed: Path of the Chronicler omits “bonus dice”; “supplicance” (Path of Service). Also Core p.78.

options.name: Path of the Artisan
options.text:
Embracing an aesthetic pursuit, you have dedicated a lifetime to learning the beauty of Aeldari culture.

You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to Scholar (Int) Tests related to the AELDARI Keyword.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of Awakening
options.text:
You devoted considerable time to the practice of scrutinising your surroundings and focusing your mind.

You gain +Rank bonus dice to Awareness (Int) Tests.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of the Bonesinger
options.text:
You tended groves of wraithbone and studied the art of psychically forming it into many useful shapes.

You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to Tech (Int) Tests on targets with the AELDARI Keyword.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of the Celebrant
options.text: Mirroring the Path of the Mourner, you celebrated births, alliances, and victories on behalf of more stoic kin. You gain +Rank maximum Wounds.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of the Chronicler
options.text:
You aggregated as much essential knowledge as you could, ensuring it would survive long after your death.

You gain +Double Rank on Investigate (Int) Tests related to the AELDARI Keyword.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of the Cultivator
options.text:
You raised and protected living creatures too vulnerable to protect themselves.

You gain +Rank bonus dice on Survival (Wil) Tests.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of the Diplomat
options.text:
You competed in devious political schemes with counterparts on other craftworlds.

You gain +Double Rank bonus dice on Deception (Fel) Tests against targets with the AELDARI Keyword.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of the Dreamer
options.text:
Sinking into meditative trances for days at a time, you wield your lucid dreams to resist She Who Thirsts.

You gain +Rank bonus dice to Corruption Tests.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of the Healer
options.text:
You healed the wounded and tended to the sick, spending decades caring for others.

You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to Medicae (Int) Tests on targets with the AELDARI Keyword.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of the Mariner
options.text:
You have learned to sail the void with expert precision and manoeuvrability, becoming one with your craft.

You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to Pilot (A) Tests using vehicles with the AELDARI Keyword.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of the Mourner
options.text:
You lost someone close to you and lamented them without succumbing to extremes that would draw Slaanesh.

You gain +Rank Maximum Shock.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

options.name: Path of Service
options.text:
To better aid your entire species, you dedicated yourself to supplicance, reading the needs of your fellows and bettering yourself through empathy.

You gain +Double Rank bonus dice to Insight (Fel) Tests on targets with the AELDARI Keyword.

requires.text: Not a Wraith Construct: Wraith Constructs do not have Paths (p.13).

text: You may choose a single Path you have already walked from the following list. You may have walked additional Paths; it costs 10 XP to walk a second Path, and 20 XP for each Path beyond the second.
